dhp209:1: Engaging oneself in what is not suitable,
dhp209:2: not engaging in what is suitable,
dhp209:3: abandoning the good, grasping the loved, he envies the one who endeavours for himself.
dhp210:1: Do not associate at any time with those who are loved or with those unloved,
dhp210:3: there is suffering not meeting those loved,
dhp211:1: Therefore do not hold (anything) as loved,
dhp211:2: for losing those who are loved is loathsome.
dhp211:3: There are no knots for those who hold nothing as loved or as unloved.
dhp212:3: for one who is free from love there is no grief,
dhp213:3: for one who is free from fondness there is no grief,
dhp214:3: for one who is free from delight there is no grief,
dhp215:3: for one who is free from desire there is no grief,
dhp216:3: for one who is free from craving there is no grief,
dhp217:1: Endowed with virtue and insight, principled, knowing the truths,
dhp217:3: doing the deeds that are his own,
dhp218:1: The one with desire arisen for the undeclared,
dhp218:2: will be suffused with the (awakening) mind,
dhp218:3: with a mind unconnected with sense pleasures,
dhp218:4: he is spoken of as ‘one gone upstream’.
dhp219:1: When one who lives abroad for a long time comes safely from afar,
dhp219:3: his relatives, friends and companions come and greatly rejoice.
dhp220:1: Just so, when one who has performed merit goes from this world unto the next,
dhp220:3: his merits are received just as relatives come to their loved one.
dhp220:5: The Chapter about Love, the Sixteenth
